function step(dt, actions = {}) {
  let events = 0;
  if (state.over) return events;

  // 1. elapsed & level
  state.elapsed += dt;
  state.level = 1 + Math.floor(state.elapsed / SHIFT.orderInterval);

  // 2. process actions
  events |= applyActions(actions);

  // 3. timers & simulation
  // order spawn
  state.orderTimer -= dt;
  if (state.orderTimer <= 0) {
    spawnOrder();
    state.orderTimer += orderInterval();
  }

  // patience
  for (i..) { order.patience -= dt; if (<=0) { miss(); events |= EVENT_MISS; } }
  filter orders

  // comboTimer
  if (state.comboTimer > 0) { state.comboTimer -= dt; if (<=0) { combo=0; comboTimer=0; } }

  // stove
  if (stove.active) {
    stove.fire += dt / STOVE.cookSeconds;
    if (stove.fire >= 1) { finishCook(); events |= EVENT_COOK_DONE; }
  }

  // timeLeft

  // decay animations
  chopAnim, flashGood, flashBad, shake decay
  floating/particles update

  // over check

    state.over = true; state.phase='over'; state.won = served>=ordersToServe;
    events |= EVENT_OVER; if (won) events |= EVENT_WIN;
  }
  return events;
}
